rules.logic: Fires when a GlobalProtect `event_id = "gateway-connected"` with `status = "success"` is observed for a given public_ip and machine_name with NO preceding successful `event_id = "portal-auth"` or `event_id = "gateway-auth"` for the same source within the prior 300 seconds — a fully connected VPN tunnel with no upstream authentication event, the behavioral core of the bypass. Stitches BIOC(GlobalProtect Gateway-Connected Session with Placeholder PoC Client Fingerprint) and BIOC(GlobalProtect Gateway-Connected Success With No Preceding Authentication Event) into one CVE-2026-0257 authentication-bypass incident. This rule is durable: both it and the no-preceding-authentication BIOC it stitches key on the missing authentication event, so they still fire after an attacker changes the placeholder MAC, hostname, or OS string that the fingerprint BIOC matches.
rules.name: GlobalProtect Session Without Preceding Authentication — CVE-2026-0257 Auth-Bypass Stitch
